scope: Fixed supplementary post-hoc development benchmark on previously inspected patients. This is neither prospective preregistration nor independent validation.
partition_policy: Reuse all 75 frozen patient-level outer partitions exactly; evaluate both feature representations. Binder old and new inputs are identical, so reuse exact fitted predictions rather than creating a false feature gain.
selection: Highest mean AUROC across six stratified inner validation folds, first listed configuration within 1e-12 on ties. Fit all transformations only on each inner training set. Refit selected configuration on complete outer training set. No outer test labels used to select configuration, network seed, optimization start, view grouping or training budget.

tabpfn.policy: Official frozen Nature-v2 checkpoint with four estimators and all matched input columns. No hyperparameter tuning or network inference service. Upstream training exposure cannot be exhaustively audited.

roboss.implementation: Paper bounded loss and full Gaussian training kernel with L-BFGS adaptation. Kernel exponent uses training median positive squared distance times width. Three starts: zero, ridge warm start and fixed small Gaussian start; select by training objective only. No global optimum guarantee or exact full-paper hyperparameter search claimed.

etmc.views: One scalar feature per view plus concatenation pseudo-view, fixed by feature definitions rather than labels. Compact vector adaptation, not RGB-D encoder reproduction.
etmc.selection: Record checkpoints from common training trajectories. Inner labels select epoch and architecture; no early stopping on outer test. One predetermined initialization per fold, no seed winner selection. Record consistent full-KL training losses and gradient norms; finite epochs do not establish global convergence.

svm_rbf.gamma: multiplier / feature count after training StandardScaler

legacy_adaptation_controls: Refit original small-budget RoBoSS and 50-epoch ETMC adapters on BOTH representations; retain predictions and diagnostics. They are training-budget controls, not substitutes for expanded comparators.
secondary_contrasts: new-minus-old representation changes for all seven models; expanded-minus-legacy adapters. Keep all cohorts and null/adverse outcomes.

uncertainty.estimator: Mean within-fold AUROC, fixed 25-fold equal cohort mean and equal three-cohort macro. Patient-paired positive exponential Bayesian weights shared across repeated appearances and methods.
uncertainty.primary_adjustment: Simultaneous conditional posterior bands using maximum absolute standardized centered draw over six macro contrasts. Cohort-wise ordinary 95 percent bands are descriptive. No frequentist significance claims from posterior probabilities.

permutation.features: Frozen multiscale feature definitions, no feature discovery per permutation
permutation.unit: Permute patient diagnosis once within each cohort, preserve class counts and reuse each patient's permuted label across five seeds.
permutation.splits: Auxiliary test regenerates five-fold StratifiedKFold for observed labels and for EACH permutation using the same five seeds, to ensure both classes in every fold. It is distinct from the historical fixed-partition benchmark.
permutation.refitting: Refit every training scaler, sign, FDR weight and reference normalization in all 75 partitions for every permutation. No permutation of saved prediction labels.
permutation.test: One-sided plus-one Monte Carlo p for macro AUC under no label-feature association; Holm correction for two models. This does not test relative algorithm superiority or undo feature/development selection.

sanity_checks: Finite-difference RoBoSS gradient; DS identity and manual formula; ETMC loss correspondence and model-state replay; synthetic learnability; exact train/test identity exclusion; training-only model fitting; exact frozen mean/MDCO replay.
stopping: Complete this menu once. Resume only fingerprint-matching completed artifacts. Do not expand grids, increase epochs or replace the primary model after observing outer test results. Any model failure is an explicit incomplete result, never a proxy or omitted weak score.
